maddeler.e:
تهرون (form I)
# تَهِرُّونَ (tahirrūna) /ta.hir.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of هَرَّ (harra)
# تُهَرُّونَ (tuharrūna) /tu.har.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of هَرَّ (harra) and هُرَّ (hurra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
